name: clownfish
description: A self-built AI agent on @earendil-works/pi-agent-core's basic loop — own tools, skills, sessions, and a lightweight Preact WebUI.

scripts.dev: npm run dev:server & npm run dev:web
scripts.start: npm run build:worker && CLOWNFISH_WORKER_MODULE=dist/worker.mjs tsx server/index.ts
scripts.build:worker: esbuild agent/worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/worker.mjs --external:fsevents --log-level=error --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:pty-worker: esbuild agent/pty-worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/pty-worker.mjs --external:fsevents --external:node-pty --log-level=error --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
